description.en:
Basic Attack

Chixia fires up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Chixia enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Chixia consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Chixia menembakkan hingga 4 tembakan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Chixia memasuki kondisi membidik untuk tembakan yang lebih kuat.
Tembakan bidikan yang dilepaskan setelah pengisian selesai memberikan Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Chixia mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan tembakan beruntun ke target di udara, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Chixia unleashes a flurry of shots, dealing Fusion DMG.

Whizzing Fight Spirit has 2 initial charges.
description.id:
Chixia melepaskan rentetan tembakan, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Whizzing Fight Spirit memiliki 2 charge awal.

description.en: Chixia fires up fast shots at nearby enemies, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id: Chixia melepaskan tembakan cepat ke musuh di sekitar, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en: Max Thermobaric Bullets is increased by 10 rounds. The damage of Resonance Skill Boom Boom is increased by 50%.
description.id: Max Thermobaric Bullets bertambah 10 peluru. DMG Resonance Skill Boom Boom meningkat sebesar 50%.

description.en: Each Thermobaric Bullet that hits a target during Resonance Skill DAKA DAKA! increases ATK by 1% for 10s, stacking up to 30 times.
description.id: Setiap Thermobaric Bullet yang mengenai target selama Resonance Skill DAKA DAKA! meningkatkan ATK sebesar 1% selama 10 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 30 kali.

description.en: Chixia makes a heroic entrance and fires rapidly with her dual pistols at the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id: Chixia melakukan entrance heroik dan menembak dengan cepat memakai sepasang pistolnya ke target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!

Hold Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit to enter DAKA DAKA!. In this state:
- Chixia continuously consumes "Thermobaric Bullets" to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- Tap Basic Attack to cast Basic Attack 4, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Then she exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- If 30 "Thermobaric Bullets" have been fired when Basic Attack is activated, Chixia will cast Resonance Skill Boom Boom and exit "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- Chixia exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state when all "Thermobaric Bullets" are consumed.

Resonance Skill: Boom Boom

Deal Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Thermobaric Bullets

Chixia can hold up to 60 "Thermobaric Bullets".
Inherent Skill Scorching Magazine increases Max "Thermobaric Bullets" by 10.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" for every Normal Attack POW POW on hit.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" upon casting Intro Skill Grand Entrance and Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit.
description.id:
Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!

Tahan Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit untuk memasuki DAKA DAKA!. Dalam kondisi ini:
- Chixia terus-menerus mengonsumsi "Thermobaric Bullets" untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
- Ketuk Basic Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack 4, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Setelah itu ia keluar dari kondisi "DAKA DAKA!".
- Jika 30 "Thermobaric Bullets" telah ditembakkan saat Basic Attack diaktifkan, Chixia akan melancarkan Resonance Skill Boom Boom dan keluar dari kondisi "DAKA DAKA!".
- Chixia keluar dari kondisi "DAKA DAKA!" saat seluruh "Thermobaric Bullets" habis dikonsumsi.

Resonance Skill: Boom Boom

Memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Thermobaric Bullets

Chixia dapat menyimpan hingga 60 "Thermobaric Bullets".
Inherent Skill Scorching Magazine menambah Max "Thermobaric Bullets" sebesar 10.
Chixia memperoleh "Thermobaric Bullets" untuk setiap Normal Attack POW POW yang mengenai target.
Chixia memperoleh "Thermobaric Bullets" saat melancarkan Intro Skill Grand Entrance dan Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Chixia releases a shock wave surrounding the target, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 530.00% of Chixia's ATK to enemies within the range.
description.id: Chixia melepaskan gelombang kejut di sekitar target, memberikan Fusion DMG sebesar 530,00% ATK Chixia ke musuh dalam jangkauan.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Resonance Skill Boom Boom hits will always be Critical Hits.
description.id: Serangan Resonance Skill Boom Boom selalu menjadi Critical Hit.

description.en: During Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames, for every 1 target defeated, Chixia recovers 5 Resonance Energy, up to 20 each time.
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames, untuk setiap 1 target yang dikalahkan, Chixia memulihkan 5 Resonance Energy, maksimal 20 setiap kali.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames deals 40% more DMG to targets whose HP is below 50%.
description.id: Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames memberikan 40% DMG lebih besar ke target yang HP-nya di bawah 50%.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames grants 60 "Thermobaric Bullets" and immediately resets the Cooldown of Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit.
description.id: Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames memberikan 60 "Thermobaric Bullets" dan langsung mengatur ulang Cooldown Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit.

description.en: When the Inherent Skill Numbingly Spicy! reaches max stacks, ATK is additionally increased by 30%.
description.id: Saat Inherent Skill Numbingly Spicy! mencapai stack maksimal, ATK meningkat tambahan sebesar 30%.

description.en: Resonance Skill Boom Boom increases the Basic Attack DMG Bonus of all team members by 25% for 15s.
description.id: Resonance Skill Boom Boom meningkatkan Basic Attack DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim sebesar 25% selama 15 dtk.
